Problem Statement:
A customer service system needs to reverse a given customer ID to assist with error detection during data entry. If the ID is input incorrectly, reversing the number helps identify where the mistake occurred. The system will return the reversed customer ID for further processing or confirmation with the customer. 
Sample Input:
12345 
Sample Output:
54321
